title.narrative: Loan 3072: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 06 Mar 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Interbank low value payments and payment card transactions are increased with the launch of Real-time gross settlement (RTGS) and Automated Clearing House systems, and the introduction of the card switch system. The EA upgraded several systems, including the (i) Central Securities Depository (CSD) system; (ii) Card Management System; (iii) Security Operation Center's System at NETC; (iv) Mobile NFC enablement (either HCE or TSM) and Tokenization Service. The Bank of Mongolia has introduced an innovative and interoperable mobile payments system in 2022.The National Payment System law has been approved by the Mongolian parliament in May 2017.The number of payment terminals has increased along with project expectations.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Nov 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46312/46312-001-apfs-en_4.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: -Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) implementation has been completed in NETC infrastructure in 2018.- NETC Fiber Network Extension - successfully completed in Q4 2017 and became operational.- The new ACH+ system was launched on 15 August 2019. The relevant contract has been successfully closed.-NETC card management bidding has been announced in March 2020 a through direct contracting. BOM has awarded a contract to Compass Plus company of UK in July 2020. The vendor has conducted a technical and functional training to NETC staffs and provided HWs. NETC Card management system launched in April 2022. The contract activities completed. - The contract for supply of national T card systems was awarded to Ubivelox LLC of Korea. The vendor has supplied a 1,000,000 cards to BOM by Mar 2022. The BOM helped to issue 1 million EMV contact & contactless -Cards in 2021-2022.- The contract for supply and installation of IT equipment and device for National Electronic Transactions Center (NETC) was awarded on 29 June 2020. The vendor completed supply and installations of devices. The contract is completed. - The procurement package for implementation of Mobile NFC enablement (either HCE or TSM) and Tokenization Service was re-advertised several times, in May, September 2020 and in February 2021. The contract between the BOM and the Consortium of Tridum e-Security & HPS was signed on 8 November 2021. TSP system has launched successfully on 23 November 2022 by the contractor and NETC."The project successfully completed provision of core network security devices and security network upgrade to NETC in 2017."The project successfully completed extension of NETC inter-bank core network in 2017."BOM NETC remote Data center renovation has been completed in 2019. "BOM has started the implementation of NETC Main Data center renovation project in Sep 2019. BOM and contractor finalized with uptime institute on confirmation of changes for the institute certification in 2022."The contract for supply and installation of IT equipment and device for National Electronic Transactions Center (NETC) was awarded on 29 June 2020. The vendor completed supply and installations of devices. The contract is completed. "The contract for supply and installation of Remote Working Environment Devices was awarded to JV Mobinet LLC and Vertexmon LLC on 8 July 2021. The contract is completed. The project supported the capacity building activities, public awareness raising events, study tours and various training for BOM staff on payment system, IT systems."The new payment system law has been approved by parliament in 2017."The high value interbank payment regulation (RTGS) has been renewed. The new regulation come in force with the launch of 2nd generation RTGS system in 2018."The low value interbank payment regulation has been replaced by the new ACH rules and regulations and come in force with the launch of ACH+ system in 15 August 2019."The new card payments regulation has been approved by BOM in 2019."Payments services license regulation has been approved by BOM in 2018."The new mobile payments regulation has been approved by BOM in 2019."RTGS payments and ACH payments guidance for participants have been renewed and approved by BOM in 2021."BOM and NETC have approved interbank QR code payments standards in Q1 of 2022."The new upgraded RTGS Second generation system was launched in January 2018. "BOM has completed its Core Banking System and Mongolian Unified Central Security Depository system by end of 2022. The contracts for Supply and Installation of Security Operation Center at NETC system were awarded in December 2020. Lot 1: The Security Operation Center (SOC) System implementation is completed on 29 November 2021, and NETC launched the SOC system in a production environment. Lot 2: Software subscription license of network equipment: all software licenses provided by the contractor were accepted by the BOM on 14 May 2021. Lot 3: Hardware and software for Fin Tech lab: all hardware and software supplied by the Contractor is accepted by the BOM on 14 May 2021.The contract BOM Big Data package was awarded on 6 Dec 2021. The equipment was delivered to BOM on 12 Jan 2022. The contract is completed
